# dreamrouter_networks (Data Source)

Lists the router's networks (Settings → Networks), e.g. to find the network_id for a DHCP reservation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dreamrouter_networks" "iot" {
  name = "IoT"
}

# Reserve an address on a specific network.
resource "dreamrouter_dhcp_reservation" "sensor" {
  mac        = "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:20"
  ip         = "10.0.20.5"
  network_id = data.dreamrouter_networks.iot.networks[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return the network with this name (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) Matching networks, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the router's DHCP server is enabled.
- `dhcp_start` (String) First address of the DHCP pool.
- `dhcp_stop` (String) Last address of the DHCP pool.
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name handed out by DHCP.
- `id` (String) Network ID, for network_id on dreamrouter_dhcp_reservation and dreamrouter_host.
- `name` (String) Network name.
- `purpose` (String) Purpose, e.g. "corporate", "guest" or "wan".
- `subnet` (String) The router's address with prefix length, e.g. 192.168.1.1/24; empty for WAN networks.
- `vlan` (String) VLAN ID, if any.
